description: Vennila grows suspicious after noticing bruises on Pavithra's hand and teaches Uthaman a lesson.
Indhu, a self-made woman who vows never to bow or borrow, clashes with Karna, enforcer of a fear driven patriarchy, unleashing a storm the empire never saw coming.

episodeTitle: Will Tamizh and Adithya Find Evidence?
description: Tamizh and Adithya sneak into Revathi's house to collect evidence to prove Bharathi's innocence.
After losing her parents and hearing in a tragic accident, Isai is forced to marry Vishal when her aunt Rukmini manipulates her horoscope to meet Subadra’s strict astrological beliefs.

episodeTitle: Aakash Tries To Oust Tara From The House
description: Following Bhoomi's advice, Aakash tries to oust Tara from the house, but she refuses to leave.
A humble village girl’s bold move to the city reshapes her destiny.
Circumstances separate sisters Janaki and Sandhya. Fate brings Sandhya's daughter, Maya, to Janaki's house, but when Maya’s modern attitude influences Janaki's daughter, it worries her.
Lakshmi, an orphan mistreated by her stepmother, finds hope when she meets Thiru, a suitor, only for fate to crush her dreams once again.
Cibi takes Isai out and spends time with her, but panics when she goes missing.
